answer: An agent network deters Sybil attacks by anchoring identities to bio-impedance telemetry. A verifier transmits micro-pulses through an electrode trellis attached to a living vine near a river, measuring localized capacitance. An adversary must procure discrete analog sensing circuitry and maintain dedicated biological host plants for each persona. However, ambient humidity shifts and plant transpiration alter baseline conductivity, occasionally causing false verification rejections.
